questions.q: How did Amos receive the message he spoke concerning Israel?
questions.a: Amos received the message he spoke concerning Israel in a vision given to him by Yahweh.

questions.q: What happens to the pastures and the top of Mount Carmel when Yahweh speaks?
questions.a: The pastures where shepherds usually feed their sheep and the top of Mount Carmel dry up and wither.

questions.q: Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Damascus?
questions.a: Yahweh declared punishment against Damascus because they cruelly attacked the people of Gilead.

questions.q: What did Yahweh say he would send into the house of Hazael?
questions.a: He said he would send a fire that would destroy the house of Hazael and the citadels of Ben Hadad.

questions.q: Where will the people of Aram go into exile?
questions.a: They will go into exile to the land of Kir.

questions.q: Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Gaza?
questions.a: Yahweh said he would punish Gaza because they captured whole people groups and sold them as slaves to Edom.

questions.q: What did Yahweh declare he would do to the fortresses of Gaza?
questions.a: Yahweh declared he would burn down the fortresses of Gaza.

questions.q: What will happen to the rest of the Philistines?
questions.a: All the Philistines who are still alive will die.

questions.q: Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Tyre?
questions.a: Yahweh declared punishment against Tyre because they exiled whole people groups to Edom and broke their treaty.

questions.q: What did Yahweh declare he would do to the wall of Tyre?
questions.a: He declared he would send a fire that would destroy the walls of Tyre.

questions.q: Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Edom?
questions.a: Yahweh declared punishment against Edom because he killed their own kinsmen.

questions.q: What did Yahweh declare he would do to Teman?
questions.a: He declared he would send a fire on Teman that would also burn down the citadels of Bozrah.

questions.q: Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Ammon?
questions.a: Yahweh declared punishment against Ammon because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead.

questions.q: What did Yahweh declare he would do to the citadels of Rabbah?
questions.a: Yahweh declared he would completely destroy the walls of the city of Rabbah and burn down her citadels.

questions.q: What did Yahweh declare would happen to the king of Ammon?
questions.a: Yahweh declared the king of Ammon would be exiled with all his officials.

commentary.text: Judgments against the Syrians, Philistines, Tyrians, Edomites, and Ammonites.

—GOD employed a shepherd, a herdsman, to reprove and warn the people. Those to whom God gives abilities for his services, ought not to be despised for their origin, or their employment. Judgments are denounced against the neighbouring nations, the oppressors of God's people. The number of transgressions does not here mean that exact number, but many: they had filled the measure of their sins, and were ripe for vengeance. The method in dealing with these nations is, in part, the same, yet in each there is something peculiar. In all ages this bitterness has been shown against the Lord's people. When the Lord reckons with his enemies, how tremendous are his judgments!
